name: Motora
tagline: Your vehicle's digital logbook — fuel, service, and expenses
description: Motora is a private service book for your vehicles. Log every fill-up, service, and expense in seconds, and keep the full history of each car or bike in one place — the kind of record that pays for itself when something needs proving.

It works entirely offline. There is no account to create and nothing is uploaded, so your registration details, mileage, and spending stay on your phone. Set your own currency and units, get a reminder before insurance or a service falls due, and keep a backup file you can carry to a new phone.
features: Log fuel, service, expenses, and reminders in seconds
A running timeline of everything each vehicle has been through
Reminders by date or by distance, so nothing lapses
Fuel efficiency and spending trends over time
Your currency, your units — rupees or dollars, kilometres or miles
Fully offline: no account, no sync, no tracking
Back up and restore your whole logbook as a single file
Keep insurance and registration documents on your phone, not in a drawer
Light and dark themes, or just follow your device
Multiple vehicles, each with its own record

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.reason: Used only to deliver the reminders you set yourself, scheduled on the device. Motora does not use push notifications, so no messages are ever sent to it from a server.

permissions.name: Storage
permissions.reason: Used only when you pick a file yourself — a document to attach, or a backup to save or restore. Documents you attach are copied into Motora's own private storage on the device. Motora reads and writes nothing on its own, and never scans your files.

privacy.dataDeletionNote: Everything you record stays in Motora's own storage on your device. Deleting a vehicle removes its records, 'Delete all records' in Settings › Backup and restore clears everything at once, and uninstalling the app removes all of it. Any backup file you chose to save stays wherever you saved it, under your control. Because nothing is ever uploaded, there is no copy for us to delete.

name: Quick Notes (Sample)
tagline: Fast, offline-first note taking with markdown support
description: Quick Notes is a lightweight, offline-first note taking app built for speed. Capture ideas the moment they strike — no sign-up, no sync delays, no clutter.
Notes are stored locally on your device using Room, with full markdown rendering, tag-based organization, and reminder notifications so nothing slips through.
features: Offline-first — works with zero network access
Markdown editing with live preview
Tags and full-text search
Reminder notifications for time-sensitive notes
Light and dark themes
Local backup and restore

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.reason: Used to deliver the reminder alerts you schedule for your notes.

privacy.dataDeletionNote: All notes live only on your device. Uninstalling the app, or clearing its storage from Android settings, permanently removes all data.

name: TrailFit (Sample)
tagline: Track walks, hikes, and daily steps with route maps
description: TrailFit turns your phone into a simple activity companion. Track walks, runs, and hikes with live route maps, distance, pace, and elevation.
A clean dashboard summarizes your week at a glance, and every workout is stored on your device so your history is always available — even offline.
features: Live GPS route tracking with map view
Daily step counting via device sensors
Weekly distance and pace summaries
Elevation and calorie estimates
Workout history stored on-device

dataCollected.purpose: To draw your route on the map and measure distance while a workout is being recorded. Location history is stored only on your device.
To show daily step totals. Read from your device's built-in sensors and stored only on your device.

permissions.name: Location (precise)
permissions.reason: Required to record your route while tracking a walk, run, or hike. Only active during a workout.

permissions.name: Physical activity
permissions.reason: Required to count steps using the device's activity sensors.

privacy.dataDeletionNote: Workout history is stored only on your device. You can delete individual workouts inside the app, or remove everything by clearing the app's storage or uninstalling it.
